comment: Overrides for scripts/swiftpm-notices.py, run by scripts/bundle-notices.sh from the Eko target's build phase (macos/project.yml). Keys under packages are SwiftPM identities from Package.resolved; every entry needs a reason.
preamble: Eko's own code is released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE in the source
repository). The Swift packages below are resolved for Eko.app; those it
links keep their own licenses. The Swift runtime and system frameworks ship

grdb.swift.reason: SQLiteCustom/src is the SQLite source submodule for GRDB's custom-SQLite builds. The GRDB product Eko links uses the system SQLite (GRDBSQLite system library), so none of it ships.

components.name: BoringSSL (vendored in swift-crypto)
components.reason: swift-crypto compiles its vendored BoringSSL (Sources/CCryptoBoringSSL, with fiat-crypto) into CryptoExtras, which swift-certificates' X509 links; the checkout carries no BoringSSL license files. Texts from google/boringssl at that revision: LICENSE and third_party/fiat/LICENSE.
